QuestInfo.name: [Masterpiece] Dream Marchen
QuestInfo.2: You received a gift for wearing the full set.

2.msg: Haven't you heard? I, Blair, discovered a valuable book in Helios Tower Library!\rHmm, I thought everyone knew that by now.\rKeep up, #b#h0##k!

4.msg: The librarian should be here soon... Ah, there he is!

5.msg: Hello, I'm Wiz the Librarian.\rOh! You're here too, #b#h0##k.\rA few days ago, Blair found a precious fairytale called #b#eDream Marchen#k#n, from an old pile of books in our library.

6.msg: Blair found a book of marvelous fairy tales. I'm so happy, my hands are shaking! We can't take rare books out of the library, so that's why I came in person. Blair wanted to see it here too.

7.msg: That's right. Luck follows wherever I go. Haha! The fairy tales inspired me to craft a new design with my beautiful skills -- the very design you're wearing now.

8.msg: I've also prepared a special gift when you wear the entire set,\r\n#b#h0##k. And pardon me, librarian, could I look at that book?

9.msg: (Wiz handed the fairytale book to Blair.)

10.msg: Yes, it's those eyes...\rTwo drops of mysterious eyes, blow in some beautiful magic, and... \rVoila!

11.msg: Thank you, Wiz. I couldn't have finished the gift without you! Haha.\r#b#h0##k. All of you have to do is wear the entire set. I'll give you #i2636871##b #t2636871##k when you're done preparing!\r\n#r(You can only participate in this event once per world.)\n\r#i3801870

1.0: Are you wearing the entire #rMaster Marchen Set#k? \n#b(You cannot claim the gift if you don't have enough space in your Use tab.)#k

yes.0: You got it, right? I'll see you around, then.
